title: My wife and I built a 2-player Snake game using AI
author: toygun1725

comments.author: TheKaleKing
comments.body: really cool! I played it with my gf and we loved it so much that I decided to propose. Thank you!

comments.author: toygun1725
comments.body:
**Hi everyone!**

My wife (who is a lawyer) and I (a videographer) have always had game ideas but zero knowledge of how to actually code them. One day, we had a "lightbulb moment" and asked ourselves: *"Why don't we just use AI to write the whole thing?"*

Today, we are excited to share the result: [**2playersnake.com**](https://2playersnake.com)

We followed a strictly "no-code" approach. Instead of writing lines of code, we had step-by-step conversations with various AI models. We experimented with ChatGPT (GPT-5), Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 4, and Grok at different stages, leveraging the unique strengths of each model to fix bugs and add features.

**The Journey:**

* **The Concept:** A classic snake game that two people can play simultaneously on the same screen (head-to-head).
* **The Process:** It started as a simple PC version, but then we realized, "this would be great on mobile too." AI helped us optimize the UI and controls for both platforms.
* **The Launch:** We even used AI to help us pick a domain and set up the website.

It’s a simple, functional, and competitive game that we’re quite proud of, considering we didn't know a lick of programming a few weeks ago.

We’d love for you to try it out and give us your feedback! If you find any bugs, let us know so we can "report" them back to our AI developers. 😅

**Play it here:** [2playersnake.com](https://2playersnake.com)
